# Task: <short title>

Use this template to prepare a repository issue. Once published, the issue is the authoritative task record; link it rather than maintain a second checklist here. Keep sections proportional to the task.

Status: Discussion / Ready / In progress / Complete

Issue: <URL or pending>

Branch: <descriptive task branch or not created>

## Problem and purpose

Who needs this, what problem do they have, and what outcome should change?

## Scope

- Deliverables:
- Out of scope:

## Requirements

Describe inputs, outputs, observable behavior, and relevant constraints. Include concrete examples where useful.

## Failure behavior

Describe the relevant failures and expected responses. Consider invalid input, partial completion, cancellation, dependencies, and recovery where applicable.

## Open questions and assumptions

Separate unresolved questions from agreed decisions. Identify which questions block the next increment.

## Proposed approach and decisions

Describe responsibilities and interfaces. Record important choices, alternatives, and reasons. Label proposals until agreed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] <Observable condition that establishes success>

## Implementation increments

- [ ] <Small, reviewable change and its verification>

These are candidate commits, not a required one-to-one mapping. Update this plan when discoveries remain within the agreed scope; track independent additions separately.

## Current state and verification

Record what is actually implemented, checks performed and results, and any remaining limitations. Include ownership or coordination notes if contributors work in parallel.

## Next agreed step

State the next increment, or note that it is awaiting discussion.
